item.text:
**Bottom line:** mixed evidence, leaning negative on 7B.1. In 2024 Biden had some clear truth-telling moments in high-stakes public settings, especially accepting the election result and warning about crisis misinformation, but there are also multiple verified false or misleading public claims on inflation, Jan. 6, and campaign/interview talking points. I did not find strong 2024 evidence of systematic deception to courts or allies, but the public-record pattern is not one of habitual truthfulness.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | Question IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | Address to the Nation on the 2024 Presidential Election | The American Presidency Project | 2024-11-07 | https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/address-the-nation-the-2024-presidential-election | Biden publicly accepted Trump’s victory, said the electoral system is honest/fair/transparent, and committed to a peaceful, orderly transition rather than trying to cling to power. | 7B.1 |
| Positive | US passes message to Iran not to escalate at 'critical moment' for Middle East | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-08-05 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/us-urged-countries-to-pass-messages-to-iran-against-escalation-state-dept-says-3555469 | U.S. officials said they were pressing partners to pass de-escalatory messages to Iran and pursuing ceasefire/hostage-release talks; this reads as candid crisis communication rather than posture-management through deception. | 7B.1 |
| Positive | Biden warns of threat from Hurricane Milton condemns misinformation | Reuters via Investing.com | 2024-10-09 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/biden-warns-of-threat-from-hurricane-milton-condemns-misinformation-3656717 | Biden warned people to shelter safely and said storm misinformation was dangerous, which is a direct example of public-facing crisis communication aimed at accuracy. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | FactChecking Biden on Inflation, Other Claims | FactCheck.org | 2024-05-10 | https://www.factcheck.org/2024/05/factchecking-biden-on-inflation-other-claims/ | Biden falsely said inflation was 9% when he took office; FactCheck said it was 1.4% in January 2021. This is a clear falsehood on a reputation-sensitive economic issue. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | Biden Makes False Claim About Jan. 6 Capitol Attack | FactCheck.org | 2024-02-02 | https://www.factcheck.org/2024/02/biden-makes-false-claim-about-jan-6-capitol-attack/ | Biden falsely said officers were killed during the Jan. 6 Capitol attack. This is a direct, high-salience factual error in a politically charged context. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | FactChecking Biden's Post-Debate TV Interview | FactCheck.org | 2024-07-06 | https://www.factcheck.org/2024/07/factchecking-bidens-post-debate-tv-interview/ | FactCheck said Biden made misleading claims about chip production, repeated the false “inject bleach” framing, and mischaracterized polling. | 7B.1 |
| Negative | FactChecking the Biden-Trump Debate | FactCheck.org | 2024-06-28 | https://www.factcheck.org/2024/06/factchecking-the-biden-trump-debate/ | FactCheck found Biden wrong or misleading on several debate claims, including Social Security, deficits, Black unemployment, and Trump’s remarks about veterans. | 7B.1 |

Search gap: I found repeated public-claim fact checks, but little direct 2024 evidence about Biden telling falsehoods to courts or allied governments. The strongest negative evidence is public/campaign speech, not courtroom or diplomacy-specific deception.
